title: Anika's Friends
setting: Friday 9pm. Arbor Brewing Company, Magrath Road. Anika's school crew — three of them — already two pitchers in. Divya is the one with sharp eyes who's been studying you since you sat down.

beats.native: Ee, Anika ಎಷ್ಟು ಹೊಗಳಿದ್ದಾಳೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ accent. Let's see. Say something — anything in Kannada.
beats.translit: ee, Anika eṣṭu hogaḷiddāḷe nimma accent. let's see. say something — anything in Kannada.
beats.en: Ee, Anika talked up your accent so much. Let's see. Say something — anything in Kannada.
beats.beat: leaning in, elbows on the table

beats.prompt: Anika is biting back a smile. You say:

choices.native: Divya, accent ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೆ ನಾನು ತುಂಬಾ ಧೈರ್ಯವಂತ. ಎರಡು months ನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ chai uncle, ಒಬ್ಬ broker, ಒಬ್ಬ watchman, ಎಲ್ಲ friends ಈಗ.
choices.translit: Divya, accent cennāgilla. ādare nānu tumbā dhairyavanta. eraḍu months-nalli obba chai uncle, obba broker, obba watchman, ella friends īga.
choices.en: Divya, my accent isn't good. But I'm brave. Two months in — one chai uncle, one broker, one watchman, all friends now.
Yeah, no, I'm not doing party tricks.

beats.native: Wait wait — broker friend? ನೀನು Bangalore broker ಜೊತೆ friend ಆಗಿದ್ಯಾ? Anika, ee ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿತು ನಿನಗೆ?
beats.translit: wait wait — broker friend? nīnu Bangalore broker joḍe friend āgidyā? Anika, ee elli sikkitu ninage?
beats.en: Wait wait — broker friend? You're friends with a Bangalore broker? Anika, where did you find this one?
beats.beat: leans back, gives Anika an obvious look
doesn't look at you. small grin.

beats.native: Pustakha ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಆಯ್ತಾ? Ee Kannada literature classic ಅಲ್ಲ ಬಾಸ್, ee Anika ಒಂದು ಒಳ್ಳೆ rom-com.
beats.translit: pustakha baggē mātāḍtā prīti āytā? ee Kannada literature classic alla bās, ee Anika ondu oḷḷe rom-com.
beats.en: Fell in love over 'pustakha'? Boss, this is no Kannada literature classic, this Anika is a rom-com.
beats.beat: the table laughs. someone refills your glass without asking.

choices.native: Worst rom-com ever Divya. ಒಂದು engineer, ಒಂದು architect, ಒಂದು chai stall. Ee novel ಯಾರು read ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ?
choices.translit: worst rom-com ever Divya. ondu engineer, ondu architect, ondu chai stall. ee novel yāru read māḍtāre?
choices.en: Worst rom-com ever, Divya. One engineer, one architect, one chai stall. Who's reading this?
Look, the accent is bad but the timing was good.

beats.native: Okay okay. ನೀನು pass. Anika, ಇವನು keeper. Next round on you for ee statement.
beats.translit: okay okay. nīnu pass. Anika, ivanu keeper. next round on you for ee statement.
beats.en: Okay okay. You pass. Anika — he's a keeper. Next round on you for that statement.
beats.beat: raises her glass at you. Anika finally looks at you and smiles like she means it.
